name: Remnants of Nostalgic Fantasies
source:
Remnants of Nostalgic Fantasies is a Visual Novel about a guy just existing but not really living. It's just the exact same office job he is forced to endure every day. One night his friend surprises him with an old NES console and with it, the opportunity to experience the old adventures he used to have when he was younger. A chance to escape the troubles of adulthood even if it was just for a single night.

[From [url=https://blankluck.itch.io/remnants-of-nostalgic-fantasies]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《怀旧幻想的遗迹》是一部视觉小说，讲述了一个刚刚存在但并未真正生活过的人的故事。这与他每天被迫忍受的办公室工作完全相同。一天晚上，他的朋友给了他一个惊喜，给了他一台旧的NES游戏机，并让他有机会体验他年轻时曾经经历过的冒险。一个逃离成年烦恼的机会，即使只是一个晚上。

[来自[url=https://blankluck.itch.io/remnants-of-nostalgic-fantasies]Itch.io[/url]]
